Representative Tran Issues Statement on Trump Decision to Reduce Vital U.S.-South Korea Military Exercises | Representative Derek Tran Skip to main content Representative Tran Issues Statement on Trump Decision to Reduce Vital U.S.-South Korea Military Exercises Monday, August 17, 2026 Washington, DC –  U.S. Representative Derek Tran (CA-45) issued the following statement in response to President Trump's announcement to substantially scale back joint military exercises with South Korea:  "President Trump‘s decision to gut joint military exercises with South Korea is dangerous. South Korea is one of America’s most critical allies in the Indo-Pacific. Reducing these readiness drills serves no legitimate national security objective; instead, it sacrifices vital military deterrence for short-term political posturing and transactional foreign policy.  "The consequences of compromising readiness are immediate and far-reaching. Suspending joint exercises emboldens Pyongyang at the precise moment North Korea is expanding its nuclear capabilities and supplying material support to Russia’s war effort in Ukraine. Beyond the Korean Peninsula, this decision signals to allies throughout the Indo-Pacific that U.S. security commitments are negotiable—subject to personal grievances rather than enduring strategic interests. "True national strength relies on credible deterrence, operational readiness, and unwavering commitments to key partners. Weakening our collective defense posture leaves America less secure and erodes global trust in U.S. leadership." ### Media Press Releases In the News Media Inquiries Press List Sign Up Read My Newsletter Washington DC Office 1127 Longworth House Office Building Washington, DC   20515 Phone: (202) 225-2415 Cypress District Office 6803 International Ave., Suite 100 Cypress, CA   90630 Phone: (714) 960-6483

Representative Derek Tran Issues Statement Following House Refusal To Condemn The Communist Regime Of Vietnam | Representative Derek Tran Skip to main content Representative Derek Tran Issues Statement Following House Refusal To Condemn The Communist Regime Of Vietnam Tuesday, September 1, 2026 WASHINGTON, DC –  U.S. Representative Derek Tran (CA-45) issued the following statement after the House of Representatives voted on   House Resolution 1490 : “As the son of Vietnamese refugees, the atrocities committed under the communist regime of Vietnam remain incredibly personal to me and to the diaspora I represent in Orange County. That is why today I voted against House Resolution 1490, legislation that yet again purports to denounce socialism and yet makes no mention of the suffering our community experienced under the communist regime of Vietnam.  Once again, House Republicans refused to advance an amendment I introduced to acknowledge the economic devastation, flight of hundreds of thousands of refugees by boat, and reeducation camps that imprisoned over a million people following the fall of Saigon. I am deeply disappointed that this is the second attempt in less than a year by House Republicans to divide our community through a toothless resolution that does not confront the true, brutal reality that our families lived through.  As a Member of Congress, I have been unafraid to stand against communist and socialist governments that flagrantly violate human rights. I’ve pressured the Trump Administration to demand the release of prisoners of conscience, including Le Huu Minh Tua
